tei:div.tei:p: "$ (105)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong ma'i cho ga bzhugs so/// /

(106)༄༅// na maḥshrī ka la tsakrā ya/ 'dir zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid kyi sngon du nges par sgrub dgos pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pas/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can bskyed par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba mchog dbang gong ma nyid bskur ba'i tshul ni/ bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams// 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam/ gtso bo'i zlum gtor gcig /sde drug la zlum gtor ram zur gsum re re// chos skyong dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs bshams/ bum pa dung chos gzungs thag rdo rje sogs kyang spyi dang mthun par 'cha'// slob dpon gyi drung du nang mchod rdor dril cang te'u sogs tshogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab btang*// thog mar nang mchod la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hriḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūrla sogs dang*/ oṃ huṃ badz+ra a na la sogs dang*/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma sogs sngags mtshan bzhis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pheṃ badz+ra ār l+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho// oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ un man da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki /n+ya da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+ta/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhū dza thā/ dzi gh+ra tha/ bi ba tha ma tikra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rta ya/ sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha/ sā ha yi ka bha wā n+nu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥbadz+ra (107)puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhū paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai wi t+yaṃ/ badz+ra āk+ṣa t+yaṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra wā d+yaṃ/

badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gro= /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gro= /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro= /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po= /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i= /'byung po'i= /yi dwags= /sha za'i= /smyo byed= /brjed byed= /mkha' 'gro'i= /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed mchis pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// (108)longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/gang dag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams mchod pa dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i bya ba la bar chad thams cad mi 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba dang*/ gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /ces pa'i mthar bdud bsreg pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ 'tshams rngams dang rol mo'i sgra drag po bya/ rdo rje'i ra gur sa gzhi la sogs pa dang*/ me'i gur sogs yid kyis bsams te mtshams bcad par bya'o// de nas gnas dang yo byad la rdo rje'i rtse mos nang mchod gtor/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang mchod yon dang dri dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ snang gsal dang*/ zhal zas dam pa dag dang*// rnam pa mang po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang*/ gos dang*/ rgyan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla bre la sogs pa dang*/ glu dang gar dang*/ me long dang*/ dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dag dang*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*/ nang gi dam tshig rnams (109)dang*/ dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhū paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai bi d+yaṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ= badz+ra wā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ badz+ra kā maṃ swā hā/ rol chen dang bcas te/ oṃ hoḥbadz+ra ghān+ḍe sarba dharmā ai ka pradz+nyā+e dhā ni/

swa bhā we/ sarba ā ka re/ sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/ sarba dharma ṇi swa bhā wān pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swā hā/ ces lan gsum brjod/ de dag ni sngon du bya ba'i rim pa yin no// da ni bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ spro zhing nus pa shin tu rgyas pa spros pa la dga' bas sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsgom par bya ba la 'bring du na/ thugs dkyil rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom kyang shin tu legs par 'gyur zhing*/ bsdus pa la dga' bas lha bcu gsum dang lha dgu sogs ci rigs pa dang shin tu bsdus pa la dga' bas/ lhan skyes rgyas bsdus gang rung la brten nas kyang*/ mchog dbang gong ma bskur du rung la/ spyir dbang gong ma ni bskyed pa'i rim pa la mi ltos zhing*/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi cho ga'i spros pa gtso bor gyur pa na yin pa'i phyir slob dpon de yan lag dang po'i rnal 'byor la brten pa thob cing*/ bar pa bzhi'i rnal 'byor rjes mthun pa rnams su myong ba yan chad kyis/ bdag mdun gyi cho ga med par yang bskur bas chog pa kho na ste/ rgyu mtshan dbang gong ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gdod nas grub pa rnal 'byor pa'i ye shes kyis nyams su myong ba nyid 'di'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga yin gyi rtog pas sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdul mtshon dang ras bris la sogs pa dbyibs su bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ dbang gong ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ slob ma la byin rlabs 'jug pa yang de 'dra la ma ltos pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang de 'dra des bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi slad du de ltar byed pa yang mi 'gal lo// da lta'i dus kyi rdo rje slob dpon du grags pa/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa tsam la brten pa dang bskyed rim kho na la gnas pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong cung zad skyes su chug kyang*/

yan lag dang po la brtan pa ma thob pa dang*/ de tsam thob kyang (110) yan lag phyi ma rnams rjes mthun pa rgyud la ma skyes pa dag gis ni/ bdag bskyed dang phyi rol gyi mchod gtor nges par bya ste/ dbang gong ma'i yan lag tu dgos pa ma yin kyang*/ bdag nyid bsod nams spel zhing*/ lha'i byin rlabs slob ma la 'jug pa'i dgos pa chen po yod pas so// ci ste rjes dran gyi yan lag dngos thob pa yan chad kyi rnal 'byor pas ni bdag nyid ye shes kyi rnam rol la dbang 'byor pa yin pa'i phyir/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga'i yan lag phra mo la ma ltos te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul lo zhes rtogs par bya'o// des na skabs 'dir lha dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa logs su bstan pa ltar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs kar thim gyi bar rdzogs par bsgom te bdag bskyed do/ /de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hra phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hriṃ hrīṃ/ hūṃ hūm̐ h+liṃ h+līṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su khu ba dang rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang shar dang mer rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ lho dang bden bral du khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ byang dang dbang ldan du gcib 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i// yab kyi thugs kar zla ba dang*// yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ de dag kha sbyar pa las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hi hī hriṃ hrīṃ huṃ hūm̐ h+liṃ h+līṃ badz+ra pad+ma a mṛ ta gha ṭa su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa sarba dharmā na su bi shud+dha dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swā hā// (111) zhes mang du bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhaṃ pra tits+tsha na maḥ nas/ kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ de dag ni bum pa bsgrub pa'i cho ga'o// 'di la 'og tu slob ma la khyor chu sbyin pa tsam las/ dgos don gzhan med pa'i phyir/ bum pa bsgrub pa 'di mtha' cig tu dgos pa min pa ltar snang yang rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag len yin pa'i phyir/ nan tan du bya ba kho na'o// de nas mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hā+oḥhaṃk+ṣaḥ zhes lan mang du brjod cing dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba rang gi blo dang 'tshams par yid kyis gsal btab bo// spro na bstod chen gyi tshig ji ltar 'os pa 'don pa sogs/ mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba dang mthun par dag nas brjod kyang legs/ 'on kyang yid kyis bsams pa tsam gyis chog cing gtso bo yab yum kho na sgom pas kyang rung ngo*// de nas mgron spyan drangs shing mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ

trai dhā tu ke shwa ra kā la tsakra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sa pa ri wā rāḥ twaṃ bha ga wān me wa ra do bha wa shiṣ+ya ṇāñtsa/ ces pa lan gsum gyi/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ pa d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ de bzhin du sbyar te/ āñtsa ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ pro k+ṣa naṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ dus kyi 'khor lo 'khor bcas rnams// rnam dag rdo rje'i dri mchog 'di// bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod/ oṃ shrī ka la tsakra sa pā ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes kun la sbyar te/ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rkang pa (112) gsum snga ma bzhin kun la sbyar te/ /rdo rje me tog rnam bkra'i tshogs// badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje bdug spos bla na med/ badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje sgron me 'od rab 'bar/ badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /rdo rje zhal zas ro mchog ldan// badz+ra nai wi t+ye pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje ma nyams 'bras bu'i mchog /badz+ra āk+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i mchod pa ni/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje bzhad ma'i mchod pa ni/ badz+ra ha s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /rdo rje sil snyan rnam mang po/ badz+ra bā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /rdo rje gar gyi mchod sprin 'di/ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /rdo rje glu dbyangs yig 'phrog ldan/ badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje 'dod ma'i mchod pa mchog /badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /nang mchod ni gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi ngo bo// dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po// lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyob pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter// srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i sman// lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa 'bul/

oṃ āḥhūm̐// nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang*// gzi brjid zlas sbyin lha'i dbang phyug dang*// sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan te// chos rgyal chen po brgyad la mchod pa 'bul// 'jam dbyangs grags pa pad+ma dkar po dang*// bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang*// phyag na rin chen khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*// nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang po mchod/ ༈ /rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' nyi ma dang*// sna tshogs gzugs dang zla 'od mtha' yas dang*// sa skyong dpal skyong seng ge rnam gnon dang*// stobs chen ma 'gags mi yi seng ge mchod/ ༈ /dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas rnam (113)rgyal dang*// drag po zhes bya nyi shu rtsa lnga po// sa'i 'khor lo rdzogs par skyong ba ste// tshangs pa lha dbang phyed phyed skyong rnams mchod// 'od srungs la sogs dum bu skyong ba brgyad// de ltar sa skyong sum cu rtsa lnga ni// rigs kun gcig tu mdzad pa gsang sngags kyi// rigs ldan brgyud pa rnam la mchod par 'bul/ ༈ /dus zhabs gnyis dang na len+d+ra pa dang*// zla ba mgon po 'bro ston lo tsā dang*// lha rje sgom pa sgro ston rnam brtsegs dang*// grub chen yu mo rnams la mchod pa 'bul// chos kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od zer dang*// sprul sku jo 'bum grub thob bse chen dang*// chos rje 'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer dang*// kun spangs chos rje rnams la mchod pa 'bul// byang sems chen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// kun mkhyen chos rje sgra bsgyur sku mched dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal nyang bon chos rje dang*// grub chen kun blo rnams la mchod par 'bul// 'jam dbyangs dkon bzang nam mkha'i mtshan can gnyis// nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang*// grol mchog zhabs dang lung rig rgya mtsho dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen te// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/

/phyis kyang mjug gi tshig rim pas 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o/ /oṃ kā la tsakra ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa mā ta hoḥphraiṃ swā hā/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥ ha haṃ haṃ haḥswā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄/ ha hā hi hī hṛ hṝ hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ ha/ a ā e ai ar ār o au al+ra āl+ra/ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces pas dkyil 'khor la 'bul/ bar 'dir sgos kyi chos skyong la'ang phul// thams cad kyi mthar/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+ya na mo na maḥ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' sdod chos (114)skyong srung ma thams cad/ yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad/ rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la 'bul lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshims nas// myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig /de nas bstod pa ni/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mtha' gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/

/ces 'dud nyi shus bstod/ spro zhing nus na/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang*// reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med// sa bon dang ni gsal bar dus med mtha' dag srid par sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med// mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnams bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dang ni skyes bu dpe med kun 'gro spros pa med pa ste// (115)ther zug tu gnas snyan dang shangs dang zhal dang spyan dang dbu dang phyag dang zhabs ni thams cad pa// 'byung ba'i mtha' te 'byung po'i mgon po mchog gi srid pa gsum 'dzin rgyu rnams dag gi rgyur gyur pa// rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gis rtogs bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal// spro byed nus ma'i gzugs gzhan glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can// ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas// bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo// sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su bskor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te// dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi bzad rnams la mi bzad pa// gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de yi 'bras bu de bskyed pa// 'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum bskyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo// gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang*// steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang*// shin tu ring po yon tan med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'am skyes pa bud med min// gang zhig kun gyi brten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/

ces pas kyang bstod do/ /oṃ dz+nyā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ ces rjes chags kyis mchod cing nga rgyal bzung de nas lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas brtsams/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gi bar gyi phrin las bcol ba yan chad gtor chog (116) gtor ma 'bul/ 'byung po spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang btang*/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ces sogs shis brjod bya/ mchod gtor gyi rim pa'o// de nas spro zhing lcogs na bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la mdzad pa ltar/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i don la sngon 'gro'i maṇ+ḍal nas brtsams te/ mchog dbang mtha' dag bdag 'jug gi tshul du rdzogs par blangs na shin tu legs shing*// spyir slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug ma blangs kyang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'am yan lag nyams par 'gyur ba ni ma yin no// de dag gi skabs 'di la ltos pa'i slob dpon gyi bya ba rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// de nas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor khang ba'i phyi rol lam/ yol khang gi phyi rol du mngon tu phyogs pa la sbyang ba ni/ bgegs gtor rnams bshams/ bsangs sbyang 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma'am mtheb kyu gsum po rim gyis bskor la/ oṃ sarba bighā bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu kha bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gṛ h+ṇi daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ ces lan gsum/ 'dir slob ma rnams la dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig /zhi bas sbyang ba'o/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa pā ya gṛ h+ṇa pā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bir+ya rā dza huṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo'am chang bu bskor/ 'dir slob ma 'di rnams la dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /ces pa ni zhi drag byed mas sbyang ba'o// hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas nas bden stobs brjod la/ mthar drag po'i mtshams rngams rol chen dang bcas pas bskul ba ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi (117)bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlab kyis 'dir slob ma 'di rnams la dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag /deng dpal rdo rje shugs kyi bka' thos pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas bar myur ba nyid du song shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /bsdu na de tsam mam shin tu spros pa la dga' na phyag rgya dang mtshon cha dgod pa sogs byas nas/ bstod dbyangs rgyas pa sngon du 'gro bar byas kyang rung la spros pa 'bring tsam gyi dbang du byas na/

rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs dang*/ rje bo sna tshogs sogs dang*/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// nga ni khro rgyal he ru ka// nga ni dpal ldan dus 'khor lo// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yin// bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje shugs// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor bar// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis// lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya// gal te kha cig bdag tshig 'da'// 'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min// rdo rje'i rā gur rab tu brtan// rdo rje khro bo'i sprin spros nas// mtshon cha yig 'bru me phung 'bar/ bar mtshams med par mtshams bcad do/ /ces nyungs kar gtor gu gul sogs kyi (118) dud pas bdug rol mo'i sgra bsgrogs te/ bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyi rol du dor te/ drag pos sbyong ba'o// bsdus pa la mos na/ bka' bsgo ba yid kyis byas nas sngags tsam brjod do/ /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge paṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis ded ste/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til lam nyung dkar la thim/ bsangs sbyangs 'bar ba'i me nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o// oṃ badz+ra ḍa ki kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes til lam yungs kar g.yas g.yon tu bskor nas/ g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen por bskyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang du blug go /sdig pa sbyang ba'o// skabs 'dir spros pa la dga' na drug bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas byur gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyag len yang gda' te mi 'gal lo// de nas 'di skad ces/

khyed rang rnams kyi mgo bor ū yig dang*/ snying gar ī yig dang*/ gtsug tor tu ā yig ste/ thabs kyi rigs gsum dang*/ lte bar l̥̄ yig dang*/ mgrin par ṝ yig dang*/ gsang bar āḥyig ste shes rab kyi rang bzhin yi ge gsum gyis srungs shing rgyas btab par mos shig /de nas sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa dang chos spyi 'gro'i bshad pa cung zad byas nas/ 'dir rdzogs rim thams cad kyi mthar thug zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la sngar ma smin na smin byed kyi dbang dgos la/ sngar smin yang ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir du/ skabs 'dir nges par dbang gong ma rnams bskur dgos shing*// gang zag dbang po dman pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung bar/ thun mong gi smin byed byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun thob na (119)legs mod/ yang gsang 'dus bde mchog dgyes rdor sogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bsdus rgyud phal cig gi rjes su 'brangs te/ 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub phal cher la grags pa'i/ cho ga rnam dag gcig gi steng nas bum dbang du grags pa de thob na yang*// byis 'jug dang don gyi gnad gcig pas legs te/ go rim ma 'chol zhing*/ spyir btang gyi bshad pa'i rim pa dang mthun/ dbang po dman pa rnams la de ltar 'thad cha shas che/ 'on kyang dbang po rnon po rnams dang*/ dbang brtul la yang bsam pa dang dgos pa'i khyad par gyi dmigs bsal la byis 'jug gi dbang ngam/ de'i dod po sngon du ma song bar yang*/ mchog dbang bskur du mi rung ba ma yin te/ dbang bskur ba ni sdom pa 'bog pa'i chog yin la/ sdom pa 'bogs yul la 'bogs chog byed pa/ gsangs sgrogs su 'gyur ba'i go skabs nam yang yod pa ma yin zhing*/ 'on kyang go rim bsgal ba'i skyon yod snyam na de yang spyir btang dmigs gsal kyi khyad yin te/

dge bsnyen la sogs pa'i sdom pa sngon du ma song bar snyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir skabs slob ma rnams sngar dbang ji ltar rigs pa thob ma thob dang bstun nas/ de dang mthun pa'i brda sprod bya/ sngon 'gro'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu zhes brjod la/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi// khyed kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos byar gzhugs te/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung par bgyi// rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyong bar bgyi// ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa (120)rnams ni bskyong bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ ces lan gsum mo// bsdus pa la mos na sngon 'gro da tsam gyis chog la/ 'bring po la mos na/ de rjes slob ma'i gnas drug tu dri bzang gi thig le dngos su byed pa'am byas par mos la/ dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ lte bar hoḥgatsug tor du haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥrnams su gyur/ ces brjod oṃ āḥhū ྃ zhes nang mchod nas slob ma'i lus la bdud rtsi gtor la srung ba byas par mos/ de nas cung zad spro na bum chu nas bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chu blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig srung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ ces brjod/ bla ma dang dus kyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnams pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par mos pa gyis shig /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ ā a aṃ aḥbadz+ra sa twa ma hā su kha badz+ra kā la tsakra shiñtsa s+ya a bhi mu kho d+bh+ra wa san+tuṣ+ṭo bha wa ba ra do bha ba/ kā ya bā ka tsit+ta ta a dhiṣ+ṭha naṃ ku ru ku ru swa hā/ ces mang du bzlas ste rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba'o// cung zad spros pa la dga' na rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyer lnga sbyin par yang bzhed de mi 'gal lo// de nas bum chu dud chos kyis blangs nas/ oṃ haṃ haṃ

sogs bum pa'i sa bon rnams lan mang du brjod la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ a i ṛ u li pañtsa dha tu bi shwodha ni swā hā/ zhes pas khrus gsol zhing 'thung ngu gzhug go /'di skabs phyag len lugs gcig la slob ma lta gon gyi khyor chu'i sngags kyis sbyin par mdzad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ bum sgrub dang 'brel pa'i (121) phyir 'di nyid legs so// sngon 'gro shin tu spros pa la mos na/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gyis mdzad pa'i gong ma'i dbang mchog bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas su bshad pa ltar/ slob ma sta gon gyi chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang*/ phyi dkyil gyi 'jug pa'i cho ga rags pa rnams sbyor ba'i lugs kyang yod pa/ dbang gong ma'i yan lag tu mi dgos mod/ slob ma'i mos pa dang bstun nas byed pa yang mi 'gal lo// dngos gzhi'i thog mar 'di skad ces bya ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang*// mtshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba dag /sngags kyi de nyid kyis mi bya// byas na byang chub rnyed par dka'// zhes gsungs pas/ dbang gong ma rnams ni rdul tshon la sogs pa phyi dbyibs bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor du bskur ba ma yin la/ chu dbang la sogs pa bum dbang du bshad pa yang*/ de ltar ming btags pa tsam ste dbang bzhi'i nang tshan gyi bum dbang ma yin pa dang dbang bzhi ni gong ma kho na las phye ba yin par mthar thug gi rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa yin zhing*/ des na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang*/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes 'jig rten pa'i dbang*/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang rnams bskur ba yin pas/

de ltar go dgos shing dbang bskur ba po ni thams cad la rdo rje slob dpon te/ de yang bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas zhal sku rdo rje la bum dbang*/ g.yon zhal gsung rdo rje la gsang dbang*/ mdun zhal thugs rdo rje la sher dbang*/ rgyab zhal ye shes rdo rje la bzhi pa rnams zhu ba'i bsam pa bskyed dgos/ de la thog mar mchog dbang bzhi po spyi khyab kyi don du/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya dang*/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa rin po ches phyur bur bkang bar mos la maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ ces brjod cing slob mas kyang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi// dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud// (122)mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba// ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems ni 'gyur med bde// dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni// mgon pos da ni bka' drin mdzod// bu dang chung ma sogs bcas pa// bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs// ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar// bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /ces pas thun mong du gsol ba btab/ /de nas bum dbang nyid kyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la// lus la sku rdo rje'i byin brlabs 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin// mi phyed rdo rje gsum sgom pas// sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni// byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// mi phyed rdo rje gsum sgom pas// sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni// byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slar yang bum dbang dngos gzhi'i don tu gsol ba lan gsum 'debs pa ni/ oṃ oṃ pradz+nyā u pa yau ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ da dā tāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyi dpral ba'i oṃ yig dkar po las/

oṃ yig 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas/ lus kyi dri ma dag /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rjes byin gyi brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ rol chen bya zhing*/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i lus kyi thig le dang*/ sad pa'i gnas skabs 'gags shing*/ dga' ba'i dga' ba rdzogs nas/ sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces slob ma'i ched du sangs rgyas rnams la bla mas gsol ba gdab bo// de ni bum dbang gi byin brlabs dbab pa'o// de nas bum dbang dngos ni/ sngar (123)phul ba'i phyag rgya de nyid sna tshogs yum du byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// zung zhig khyer cig sems dpa' che// zung la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes rig ma gtad/ de'i nu ma la lag pas reg pas/ de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba'i 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' ba'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid bum pa'i dbang gi don no// de ltar na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge tshul du gyur cing*/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo bar lung bstan pa thob pa sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra sa twa na badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ka ṇa a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra sa twa pu tro a tsa lā bhū mi la ྦྷྡྷོ haṃ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ ngag la gsung rdo rje'i byin brlabs gzhug pa'i don du gong gi tshig bcad la/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ ces 'don pa spos te lan gsum gsol ba gdab/

gsang dbang dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā u pa yo gu h+ya a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba gdab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyi/ mgrin pa'i āḥyig dmar po las/ āḥyig 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas ngag gi dri ma dag /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ rol chen bya/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i ngag gi thig le dang*/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs 'gags shing*/ mchog dga' dga' ba rdzogs nas/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod (124)rdzogs pa'i sku rnam pa nyi shus mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces bla mas brjod de gsang dbang gi byin brlabs 'bebs pa'o// de nas gsang dbang dngos ni/ oṃ dwā da sha ad ga ni ro dha ka ri ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ gdong g.yogs bcings par bsam pa'am dngos su bcings/ /de nas bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs nas sku la zhugs pa/ chags pa chen pos zhu bar gyur/ a wa dhu tī'i lam nas brgyud de nor bur byon pa'i bdud rtsi mthe bong dang ming med kyis bzung nas lce thog tu bzhag par gyur// 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi/ /zhes dang*/ bla med de ni 'di nyid de// gnyis su med cing mi 'gyur ba// chos kyi dbyings ni dam pa yi// yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam te/

a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod de/ dngos su bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod kyi thigs pa lan gnyis su lce la bzhag cing btung bar bya'o// mig dar bsal/ oṃ de byen dra ya ṇa rgyu da gha ṭa ya swā hā/ phyag rgya'i bha ga gsal bar byas pa yang bltas te/ de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi mchog dga'i dga' ba ste/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge slong du gyur cing*/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros su lung bstan pa thob pa sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pa yin no/ /ces brda' sprad la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sa twe na gu h+ya a bhi ṣik+to badz+ra sa twa/ yu ba rā dzo na bhu mi lab+dho haṃ/ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ yid la thugs rdo rje'i byin brlabs 'jug pa'i don du/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ ces gong gi tshig bcad la 'don (125) ba sbos te gsol ba gdab/ shes rab ye shes dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ huṃ pradz+nyā u pa yau badz+ra sa twa bi shwa mā ta rau/ pradz+nyā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab/ de nas bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer zhes sogs// byin rlabs dbab pa snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba las/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngon po las/ hūm̐ yig 'od zer sngon po 'phro ba/ snying ga nas zhugs yid kyi dri ma dag /thugs rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs/ /ces dang*/ yid kyi thig le dang*/ gnyid stug gi gnas skabs 'gags/ khyad dga'i dga' ba rdzogs/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku rnam pa lngas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa/ ces kyang 'don pa spo'o// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos ni bla mas/ sngar phul ba'i rig ma de slob ma la gtad par mos la/

'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po lags// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i dpang por byas nas// gzung ma yid 'ongs 'di khyod kyi// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yi// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ /zhes go bar byas/ phyag rgya sna tshogs yum du byas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ phyag rgya des kyang chu skyes gur gum la sogs pa'i dri bzang por byas pa ston cing*/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas bstan byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas te// sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas// bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte ba hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ shes rab kyi pad+ma āḥlas (126)pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dbus su āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas mtshan par gyur/ lag bcangs dang gnyis sbyor gyi sgo nas snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ dz+nyā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur pa ni/ 'jigs rten kun rdzob kyi dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don to// de rnams ni dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas/ kun rdzob kyi dbang rnam pa bzhi'o// de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor tu shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/

sngags kyi tshul la gnas brtan tu gyur cing*/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas par lung bstan pa thob pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis par gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad la/ oṃ huṃ badz+ra sa twe na/ pradz+nya dz+nyā ne na a bhi ṣe ke na a bhi ṣi k+to dwī tī ya/ badz+ra dha ro3 haṃ/ dharma me gha bhu mi lab+dho3 haṃ/ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos so/ /de nas bla mas/ dam tshig gi nges pa sbyin pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba de ni don dam pa ma yin gyi/ don dam par rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bde ba ni thig le 'pho ba med pa yin pas bde ba chen po'i rten thig le ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*// ye shes phyag rgya'i rjes chags la'ang*// bde ba chen po byang chub sems// brtul zhugs brtan pos bsrung bar bya// bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas// byang chub sems ni spro mi bya// khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i// sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya// srung ba 'di nyid kho na yis// skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid// tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs// bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan// pha rol phyin bcu thob (127)pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug /'di yis rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// rang dang gzhan don sgrub pa'i slad// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// khams gsum phyag byas ye shes ni// 'di las gzhan pa yod ma yin// skyob pa kun gyi sdom pa ni// gal te khyod srungs bdag gi bu// de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin rlabs rdzogs byang chub thob gyur// ci te chags pas zil mnan bdag /gtso bo'i mdun du blangs nas ni// sdom pa skyong bar mi byed na// de tshe ngu 'bod du 'gror 'gyur// dman pa'i sems las skye gnas su// gang tshe byang chub sems lhung 'gyur// de tshe phyag rgyar shes nas ni// pad+ma'i phyi rol rang lces blangs/

/zhes brjod par bya ste/ sdom pa sbyin pa'i nges pa'o// spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir gal lte g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis zhes sogs rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ston pa'i rgyud tshig rnams brjod nas don yang bshad do// slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa'i bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas gsol ba gdab po/ /de nas bla mas bu khyod nyon cig kun rdzob ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi thun mong gi bde ba/ dga' ba bcu drug gi mtshan nyid ni// 'dod pa spyod par byed pas 'gro ba rang gi yid la'o gang ba dag ni gang ba nyid du 'gyur// gang ba yan lag mchog la ri bong 'dzin pa khu par byas nas 'bar ba'i thig le bzang po 'dzag /oṭ+ṭas bkug pa mchog gi bde ba rang bzhin gyis ster thig le grol ba dag ni gsum gyi mthar/ blta dang reg dang 'grogs las 'dzag pa'i bde ba 'di dag gis ni dga' ba la sogs dbye bas te// 'dod pa dga' ba byed de dang po dag kyang mi rnams kyis ni mig gis blta ba rnams kyis so// phyi nas gang bas rab tu sbyar ba yis te slar yang mchog gi dga' ba nyid de rang lus (128)la// 'bar ba nyid la thig le 'dzag pa'i dga' ba yis kyang khyad par dga' ba rdo rje pad+ma la// oṭ+ṭa thig le gsum gyi mtha' ru 'gyur ba la gnas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rdo rje byed/ ces dga' ba bzhi dang de dag re re la yang*/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ sems dang*/ ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba dga' ba bcu drug tu 'gyur ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ chags bral dang po chags pa che// kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od// rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas// sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos 'dzin pa/

/zhes dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang*// cha med cha las 'das pa po// bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang*// zhes thig le 'pho ba med pa don dam pa'i dga' ba bzhi yang sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba ni de kho na nyid bcu drug yin la/ 'jig rten kun rdzob pa'i shes rab ye shes ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes tsam ste/ don dam pa ma yin gyi des nye bar mtshon pa 'jig rten las 'das pa dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ni don gyi ye shes te/ de kho na nyid kyi don yin no// zhes 'pho ba med pa'i don dam pa spros pa dang bral zhing stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes la 'dun par bya ste/ de yan chad dbang gong ma chung ngu zhes bya ste 'jig rten pa'i dbang gsum pa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa'o// de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ ye shes la ye shes rdo rje'i byin brlabs gzhug pa'i don du/ dpal ldan ye shes rdo rje 'dzin// mi phyed rdo rje bzhi bsgom pas/ /zhes pa dang phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// mi phyed rdo rje bzhi bsgom pas/ zhes gong gi tshig bcad la gdon pa spos te gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi pa dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ hoḥpradz+nyā u pā yau/ āt+ma kaṃ badz+ra satwa ma hā mu dra dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me dra yats+tsha/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥphaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sogs// byin brlabs dbab pa (129) snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba las/ /lte ba'i hoḥyig 'od zer 'phro ba/ lte ba nas zhugs/ chags rtog gi dri ma/ ces dang*/ ye shes kyi thig le dang bzhi pa'i gnas skabs lhan skyes kyi dga' ba/ ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par ces kyang 'don pa spo'o// de nas dbang bzhi pa dngos ni/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang chen dbang gis ni// khyod kyi sems rgyun dbang bskur ro/

/zhes brjod la rkang pa skyil krung*// lus drang por srong*/ lta stangs g.yo ba med par byed du bcug la/ 'di skad ces de ltar yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dngos po med la sgom pa med// sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin// da ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las gsungs pa// shes rab ye shes dag ni sems dang de'i snang ba dag kyang rnam pa bcu po nyid du 'gyur// dbang ni dri med ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan lta bu 'di la zhugs pa gang yin pa// de las mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba 'pho med lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med nyid ni bzhi pa ste// sangs rgyas zhal ni gang gi thugs dang zhal la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o// zhes pa'i don chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa dang bral zhing*/ blo rnam par rtog pa snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin par shes par byas nas/ ci yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyams par bzhag par bya'o// de las yan lag drug gi rim pas thob pa/ phyag rgya chen po dang mi 'gyur pa'i bde ba bzung du 'jug pa'i ye shes so so rang gis rig par 'gyur ba ni/ gong ma'i gong ma chen po bzhi pa'i ye shes so// de ltar don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur pa'i (130)dbang bskur ba thob pas/ skye dgu'i bdag po sa bcu gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad la/ oṃ hoḥdharma dhā tu āk+ṣa ra tsa tur+tha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to/ badz+ra sa tā+e na/ āt+ma nā haṃ/ dwi tī yo/ dwa da sha bhu mi lab+dho/ badz+ra sa twa/ ma hā ār+thaḥs ra ma a k+ṣa raḥ trai lo kya bi dza yaḥkā la tsa kro bha ga bā na/ e baṃ ka raḥ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/

don dam pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab ye shes dbang gong ma chen po zhes bya ba dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems// dpal ldan bla ma khyed spangs nas// bla ma gzhan dag rmi lam du'ang*// srog dor nas ni sten mi bya// gzhan yang de bzhin dus kun tu// g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis// lus ngag sems dang gsum po ni// gtso bo'i spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes rjes zlos kyis dam 'cha' ru bcug /gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ btang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul bar bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi// khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /ces rjes zlos lan gsum dang dge ba bsngo// bar 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am dpa' bo'i ston mo bya// gtor ma gsar du bsham pa'am snga ma rnams kha gsos la/ lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ gtor ma byin brlabs nas gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar rnams btang la/ spyi dang mthun par rdo rje'i glu blangs pa'am/ ma blangs kyang rung ste/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sogs shis pa brjod do// rjes chog gi mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ oṃ āḥhuṃ ha phaṭa nas dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhuṃ ho trai dhā tu nas shiṣ+ya ṇāñtsa/ gan+dhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis sngags tsam gyis phul nas/ oṃ kā la tsakra sogs kyis gong ba zin nang mchod phul/ mchog sbyin rdo rje sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bstod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang (131)ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ nus mthu'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/

sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs/ badz+ra muḥmagron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim/ /zhes brjod/ gsang bar haṃ yig zhes pa dang*/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshig gang 'os bya'o// ces pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang gong ma bskur tshul/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po yab sras kyi phyag bzhes phyin ci ma log pa de bstan zin to// ces pa 'di'ang don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor*/ tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas dpal jo mo nang du'o/// /bkra shis/// / (132)
